overview: Maple Ridge had 90,990 residents in the 2021 Census, up 10.6 percent from 82,256 in 2016, and 33,103 occupied homes spread across 267.82 square kilometres. That growth means a steady stream of new households looking for trades, services and shops they have not chosen yet.

About a third of local business licences are home-based, tourism tied to Golden Ears Provincial Park brings outside visitors, and farmland covers part of the city. Businesses here compete with many small local operators, so visibility and trust count.

byService.lead-generation: Because Maple Ridge grew 10.6 percent between 2016 and 2021, lead generation should target newly arrived households early, before they settle on a contractor, dentist or regular shop.
byService.seo: Search plans in Maple Ridge should cover neighbourhood names like Albion, Silver Valley and Haney, and capture visitors searching for services on their way to Golden Ears Provincial Park.
byService.website-development: With so many home-based businesses competing in Maple Ridge, a fast, professional website that shows real reviews, hours and service areas quickly separates a firm from hobby operators.
byService.branding: Maple Ridge branding works best when it feels local and outdoorsy, reflecting the farms, rivers and park access that residents value, rather than borrowing a generic Vancouver look.
